summary: Quiet Saturday for packs, with Breakpoint opening in London today. Pokémon mood turned sour: a big trader account says sell TCG now, sealed flippers are stuck with product, and Target cut its pack limit to one. Collector Crypt keeps posting big numbers ($201.8M packs in 30 days per one recap, and more 24h fees than Raydium AMM per another), while Jupiter pushes a Gacha Battlepass with volume rewards. Only one small Solflare Packs mention, a pull post from our ambassador @AiFlippa.
